overview_description.description:
ShalaOnline is the first online streaming platform that offers both English and Arabic yoga and meditation classes. All our classes are taught by hand-picked certified and experienced teachers.

We aim to offer you the convenience of practicing yoga in the comfort of your home, or anywhere in the world. You always have on-the-go access to your favorite classes and teachers.

With ShalaOnline you can Practice anytime and for as long as you want. Don’t worry about making it on time for a class and don’t lose time on the road. Whether you have 5 minutes in the morning or a full hour at the end of your day, your favorite classes are available 24/7.

identifier.value: Tamara Hachem Founder and CEO @ Shala Online
